title: Network Device Details
description: List of network devices to fetch data

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: List of devices to execute commands on

port.title: SSH Port
port.description: SSH port number (default: 22 if not provided)

commands.title: Additional Commands
commands.description: Additional commands to execute (will be combined with default commands, duplicates removed automatically, not used for tech support collection)

problemDescription.title: Problem Description (AI Command Generation)
problemDescription.description: Optional: Describe the network issue and AI will generate diagnostic commands automatically. Example: 'High CPU usage and slow response times' or 'Network interface keeps dropping connections'

includeWarnCommands.title: Include Potentially Dangerous Commands
includeWarnCommands.description: When using AI command generation: Check this to include WARN-level commands that might modify system state (service restarts, process kills, etc.). Uncheck to only run safe, read-only commands.

cohereApiKey.title: Cohere API Key
cohereApiKey.description: Optional: Cohere API key for AI command generation

techSupportCollection.title: Enable Tech Support Collection
techSupportCollection.description: Enable to collect comprehensive tech support data from devices for in-depth analysis. This may include sensitive information, so ensure you have proper authorization before enabling.

mongdbConnectionString.title: MongoDB Connection String
mongdbConnectionString.description: [Used only if techSupportCollection is enabled]: MongoDB connection string to store collected data
